text: On October 4, 2021, a Zoning By-law Amendment application was submitted to permit a 20-storey mixed-use building with 357 square metres of retail space on the ground floor and 181 residential dwelling units. The applicant appealed City Council's neglect or failure to make a decision on its application for the Zoning By-law Amendment (the "Appeal"), to the Ontario Land Tribunal on January 24, 2022, citing City Council's failure to make a decision within the time period prescribed under the Planning Act. A Case Management Conference was held on June 6, 2022, and the Ontario Land Tribunal has scheduled a 10-day hearing commencing on May 31, 2023. On March 6, 2023, the applicant submitted with prejudice revised plans for a modified proposal. Given the timing of the hearing, the City Solicitor requires further directions on this matter no later than the completion of the City Council meeting…
